verdict.rationale: Keycloak's own documented bulk mechanisms are realm import/export as JSON (including automated realm import via the operator) and authorization-configuration export/import. These move many users, clients and roles at once, but only as whole-configuration loads, not targeted bulk actions on selected items. The Admin CLI (kcadm.sh) and REST API support scripting, but that is a building block rather than a bulk-operation feature, and community reports say realm JSON is hard to keep in sync after the initial load. Missing for 10: documented bulk-action endpoints or UI multi-select operations (e.g., bulk user disable or role assignment), SCIM bulk support, and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
